Corrected clear transcription errors: Subscribenten, insigniter, Annotationibus, Henrici, recensuit, Livium, c. Integr. (cum), Gronovii Notis, Schreib-Median-Papier, Exemplar. Historical spellings (künfftige, währet, verkaufft, Preiß, biß) were kept."}
